scope.metadata: Existing R5 periodic/correction/supplement indexes for only these three securities; no new index requests
scope.gold_ids_used_only_for_scoring: Known IDs must not be predicates in discovery implementation

baseline_title_rule: B0: clean announcementTitle contains 更正; emits candidate only, never numeric change

candidate_rules.rule: Title contains 更正|修订|更新前|更新后 => candidate; no issuer or ID exceptions
Title contains 补充 and also 年度|报告|财务|会计 => candidate, not necessarily S07 numeric change

Group full periodic-report records by issuer and normalized report period; >=2 distinct IDs or dates => repeated-period version candidate. Exclude 摘要|英文|H股; content SHA difference signals document bytes only, not numeric changes
Available body contains 追溯|重述|会计政策变更|比较期间|调整前|调整后|补充修订 => candidate. Box states/semantics require triage; not a proven field change

On each first matching 主要会计数据和财务指标 summary page among first 30 physical pages, use common NP/OCF/EQ labels and adjacent comma-grouped amount tokens. No issuer-specific page numbers, sign/unit overrides or exception IDs. Capture source amount and first3 columns; source unit must appear near label or in page header; ambiguity => UNKNOWN

For same issuer and same period, compare machine-extracted NP/OCF/EQ only when report-period, unit and column identity resolved. Same hash/ID version identity not inferred from numeric equality. Different numeric values => field-change evidence; equal triples do not prove entire report unchanged
Comparative amount change candidates require explicit adjusted/unadjusted column ordering; EPS-only adjustment never proves NP/OCF/EQ changed. No revised fields from keyword alone.

v1_extraction_guard: If no reliable matched summary page, field labels, unit or period/column, emit UNKNOWN instead of reading unrelated figures; retain first failures. Full-document semantic review separately classified agent-assisted, not automatic.
asof_diagnostic: Reuse R4 candidate next actual trading session close for date-only announcements; no product rule freeze. Add only positively supported original/revised facts. Unrelated correction has no replacement values; conflicting/unknown versions fail closed.
cost: A actual download/parser/detector execution; B explicitly timestamped agent review spans incl latency; C HUMAN_REVIEW_TIME=NOT_MEASURED; no accepted human cap assumed
no_generalization: Fixed known cases only; no unknown revision recall, no population precision/exception rate, no SLA
